subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-11-19
html:

All three are still coming_soon in catalog.ts (only GA4, Search Console, Google Ads, YouTube, PageSpeed, and Google Business Profile are live) — fixed 4 posts that made the claim, left 1 post's two other mentions untouched after confirming in context they're not overclaims (pain-point framing / generic industry description, not a claim about ARLO).

Metrics: rank flat 0/22 tracked keywords (31st straight session), backlinks flat 2/1 referring domains, Domain Trust flat at 6, AI Result Tracker still has zero LLM engines configured. CI: 67/67 SEO Report Email runs green all-time going into this push. The low-KD MCP-integration connector matrix (5/5) and comparison hub (5/5) remain fully built — 14th straight session with nothing new to add there.

Next: blog-post trust-fix sweep is now fully closed (schema, metadata, homepage copy, and blog body copy all re-confirmed accurate against catalog.ts). With no fresh overclaim found this session, the next session should either fix sitemap.ts's fake "modified now" lastModified timestamp, or run a fresh catalog.ts audit pass against the /destinations/* pages — the same technique that has caught every bug in this family so far.
